scenes.en: Cleaning your glasses with your shirt?
scenes.say: Still cleaning your glasses with your shirt? Stop! Here is the right way.
Step one. Rinse your glasses under plain running water to wash away dust.

scenes.en: One drop of mild soap, rub gently
scenes.say: Step two. Add one drop of mild dish soap, rub gently with your fingers, and rinse again.

scenes.en: Dry with a clean microfibre cloth
scenes.say: Step three. Dry them with a clean microfibre cloth.

scenes.en: Shirts and tissues can scratch your lenses
scenes.say: Don't use your shirt or tissue paper. They can scratch the lens. When you are not wearing your glasses, keep them in their case.

scenes.en: Scratched lenses or blurry vision? Get an eye test.
scenes.say: Scratched lenses or blurry vision? Get your eyes tested by an eye specialist.
